🛟 Jesse stands up by the fire. "The sick can't wait us out. Somebody has to say it, so: we need a plan, tonight. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"We can nurse them through it, or go lean and ride it out, or send the strong out hunting while the sick rest. Say which."
"Or we rally," Jesse adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
